headline.test1: decline: surface mean -0.113 (6 sites) vs borehole -0.058 (6); borehole indicator +0.051+/-0.039 (site scatter 0.063); within boreholes 175-592 m slope +0.02+/-0.12 %/km (boot 0.33): no sensor-depth dependence. headline.lfe_lapse: surface 2-4 Hz early -0.123 vs late -0.039 (diff -0.084+/-0.022, z -3.8); boreholes -0.039 vs -0.034 (z -0.3)
headline.lfe_freq: surface 2-4 -0.146 vs 4-8 -0.105 (z -1.1); boreholes -0.046 vs -0.026 (z -1.2): no significant frequency dependence
headline.injection: paired injection recovery 0.996-1.001 in every LFE config; the unpaired recovery (0.10-0.72) reproduces the earlier sci_dvv_depth "uneven recovery" -> that correction was an artefact. Noise: band-limited injection recovered 0.96-1.0 except low-CC late windows (dropped).
headline.verdict: favours a near-surface change concentrated in the top few hundred m (decline) / top ~100-200 m (M7 step); km-scale regional change disfavoured by noise frequency+lapse pattern and by <=10-km lateral heterogeneity, but the decline depth rests mainly on KMPB ambient noise.
